title: QUACK: Questioning, Understanding, and Auditing Communicated Knowledge in Multimodal Social Deduction Agents
abstract: arXiv:2605.27068v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Social deduction games have become a popular testbed for probing reasoning, deception, coordination, and belief modeling in Large Language Model (LLM) agents. However, most environments are scored only by game outcomes such as win rates and largely remain to text-only interaction, making it difficult to tell whether an agent's language is actually grounded in what it perceived and did, or to identify the failure modes underlying its behavior. To address this gap, we introduce QUACK, an open-source environment and evaluation framework for auditing the grounding of agent language in multimodal social reasoning. QUACK evaluates agents at three levels: game outcomes, behavioral trajectories, and utterance-level consistency. Its core Statement Verification Pipeline reconstructs each agent's ground-truth trajectory from engine logs and checks every discussion claim against it, automatically flagging spatial hallucination, unsupported

translated_title: QUACK：在多模态社交推理智能体中质疑、理解与审计所传达的知识
translated_abstract: 社交推理游戏已成为探究大型语言模型（LLM）智能体中推理、欺骗、协作与信念建模能力的流行测试平台。然而，大多数环境仅以游戏结果（如胜率）作为评分标准，且大多局限于纯文本交互，这使得人们难以判断智能体的语言是否真正基于其感知和所执行的行为，也难以识别其行为背后的失败模式。为弥补这一空白，我们提出了QUACK，一个用于审计多模态社交推理中智能体语言落地性的开源环境与评估框架。QUACK在三个层面对智能体进行评估：游戏结果、行为轨迹和话语级一致性。其核心的陈述验证流水线从引擎日志中重建每个智能体的真实轨迹，并将讨论中的每一条陈述与之比对，自动标记空间幻觉、无依据的
tldr: QUACK是一个开源的多模态社交推理评估框架，它通过在游戏结果、行为轨迹和话语级一致性三个层面将智能体的每条陈述与其真实行为轨迹比对，自动检测空间幻觉和无依据陈述，从而审计智能体语言的落地性。
en_tdlr: QUACK is an open-source evaluation framework for multimodal social deduction that audits the grounding of agent language by verifying every discussion claim against reconstructed ground-truth trajectories across three levels—game outcomes, behavioral trajectories, and utterance-level consistency—automatically flagging spatial hallucinations and unsupported statements.
